---
title: "RegressionSensitivityAnalysisR"
output: html_notebook
---
Load in packages and data
```{r}
library(MCMCglmm)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(readxl)
library(BSDA)
library(scales)

RegressionData <- as_tibble(read_excel("<data path>")) #path to regression data in .xlsx table

#parameters for plotting figures
cap_width <- .01 
titlesize <- 10
labelsize <- 3


SimNum <-  5000 #number or iterations for Monte Carlo simulation. Lower to decrease run time 
RSD <- c(1E-8,.025,.05,.075,.1,.125,.15,.175,.2,.225,.25,.275,.3,.325,.35) #Steps for magnitude of random normalized error. First step is negligably small to prevent divide by 0
set.seed(12345) #set seed for reproducible results

```

Run Monte Carlo Simulation for 14C vs HS regression
```{r}
length <- length(RegressionData$C14)
c <- 1

#initialize matrices for simulation results
slope_matrix14 <- matrix(nrow = SimNum, ncol = length(RSD))
intercept_matrix14 <- matrix(nrow = SimNum, ncol = length(RSD))
slopesd_matrix14 <- matrix(nrow = SimNum, ncol = length(RSD))
interceptsd_matrix14 <- matrix(nrow = SimNum, ncol = length(RSD))

#Monte Carlo Simulation. May time a while to run
for(j in RSD){
  
  for(i in 1:SimNum){
    x <- rtnorm(length(RegressionData$HS), mean = RegressionData$HS, sd = j*RegressionData$HS, lower = 0, upper = 1)

    m <- lm(RegressionData$C14 ~ x)

    slope_matrix14[i,c] <- coef(m)[2]
    slopesd_matrix14[i,c] <- sqrt(diag(vcov(m)))[2]
    intercept_matrix14[i,c] <- coef(m)[1]
    interceptsd_matrix14[i,c] <- sqrt(diag(vcov(m)))[1]
    
  }
  c=c+1
}

#Removes uneeded variables
rm(list <- c('i','m','c','j', 'x','length'))

```

Calculate Error Threshold for Slope
```{r}

regC14 <- lm(RegressionData$C14~RegressionData$HS) #compute C14 vs HS regression
slope_ttest_14 =  matrix(nrow = length(RSD), ncol = 1)

#perform t-test for all random error levels to determine which level deviates significantly from linear regression
for (j in 1:length(RSD)){
  test <- tsum.test(mean.x <- mean(slope_matrix14[,j]),
                 s.x <- sd(slope_matrix14[,j]),
                 n.x <- SimNum,
                 mean.y <- regC14$coefficients[2],
                 s.y <- sqrt(diag(vcov(regC14)))[2],
                 n.y <- length(RegressionData$C14))
  slope_ttest_14[j] <- test$p.value 
}

#Removes uneeded variables
rm(list <- c('j', 'test'))
```

Graph of Slope vs Error
```{r}
#Finds the mean and standard of the monte carlo simulated values for each error increment
mslope14 <- colMeans(slope_matrix14)
sdslope14 <- apply(slope_matrix14, 2, sd)

slope14C <- ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x = RSD, y = mslope14))+
  geom_line(aes(x = RSD, y = mslope14))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = RSD, y = mslope14, ymin = mslope14-sdslope14, ymax = mslope14+sdslope14), width = cap_width)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin =RSD[match(max(slope_ttest_14[slope_ttest_14<0.05]),slope_ttest_14)], 
                ymin = min(mslope14-sdslope14),
                xmax = 0.35, ymax = max(mslope14+sdslope14)),
            fill = 'maroon',alpha = .2 )+
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = max(mslope14+sdslope14), label = "A", hjust = 0, size = labelsize)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,.1,.2,.3),
                     labels = c(0,10,20,30))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = titlesize),
    axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  labs(y = "Slope")


slope14C

```

Calculate Error Threshold for Intercept
```{r}
intercept_ttest_14 <-  matrix(nrow = length(RSD), ncol = 1)

for (j in 1:length(RSD)){
  test <- tsum.test(mean.x <- mean(intercept_matrix14[,j]),
                 s.x <- sd(intercept_matrix14[,j]),
                 n.x <- SimNum,
                 mean.y <- regC14$coefficients[1],
                 s.y <- sqrt(diag(vcov(regC14)))[1],
                 n.y <- length(RegressionData$C14))
  intercept_ttest_14[j] <- test$p.value
}

rm(list = c('j', 'test'))
```

Graph of Intercept vs Error
```{r}
mintercept14 <- colMeans(intercept_matrix14)
sdintercept14 <- apply(intercept_matrix14, 2, sd)

intercept14C <- ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x = RSD, y = mintercept14))+
  geom_line(aes(x = RSD, y = mintercept14))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = RSD, y = mintercept14, ymin = mintercept14-sdintercept14, ymax = mintercept14+sdintercept14), width = cap_width)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = RSD[match(max(intercept_ttest_14[intercept_ttest_14<0.05]),intercept_ttest_14)], ymin = min(mintercept14-sdintercept14),
                xmax = 0.35, ymax = max(mintercept14+sdintercept14)),
            fill = 'maroon',alpha = .2 )+
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = max((mintercept14+sdintercept14)*1.1), label = "C", hjust = 0, size = labelsize)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,.1,.2,.3),
                     labels = c(0,10,20,30))+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(x = 'Percent Relative Error on HS Content', y = "Intercept")

intercept14C
```

Combine Graphs and Save as .png
```{r}
sensitivity_plots14C = plot_grid(slope14C, slope_error14C, intercept14C, intercept_error14C, nrow = 2)
sensitivity_plots14C

ggsave(plot = sensitivity_plots14C,
       filename = "Sensitivity Plots 14C.png",
       path = "<file path>", #change to path where you want file stored
       width = 6,
       height = 4,
       unit = 'in',
       dpi = 300) 
```
